title: test_crisis_replay_identity discards crisis_record_run's events array — 512B leaked per run
evidence:
core/crisis_test.odin:53
	events := make([dynamic]Event, 0, 8)

core/crisis_test.odin:366-371
		crisis_seed_fixture(&s, cat)
		sla_draw(&s, cat, 1, 2, "wide", 1500) // the mid-run fix
		hashes, _ := crisis_record_run(&s, 2400, cat)
		return hashes

odin test core (tracking allocator):
[WARN ] --- [2026-08-13 09:02:58] <      512B/  52.83KiB> <  44.87KiB> (   90/   92) :: core.test_crisis_replay_identity
        +++ leak       256B @ 0x64980B720 [crisis_test.odin:53:crisis_record_run()]
        +++ leak       256B @ 0x649806028 [crisis_test.odin:53:crisis_record_run()]

spec change log line 133: "wrong-typed / i32-wrapping cooldown, 256-row cap); leak hygiene in crisis_record_run callers."
detail: Every other crisis test defers delete on both returned arrays; the replay-identity closure drops the events array, leaking 2x256B under the tracking allocator. project-context: 'leaks are CI failures'.
recommended_fix: Capture and free the events array: `hashes, evs := crisis_record_run(&s, 2400, cat)` then `defer delete(evs)` before returning hashes.

title: crises_256_doc builds its 256-row document on the tracking allocator and never frees it
evidence:
core/catalog_test.odin:84-97
crises_256_doc :: proc(allocator := context.allocator) -> string {
	b := strings.builder_make(allocator)
	strings.write_string(&b, `{"archetypes": [`)
...
		strings.write_string(&b, fmt.aprintf("%d", i, allocator = allocator))
		strings.write_string(&b, `", "display_name": "A", "root_cause_pattern": "p", "failure_effect": "f", "preventive_redesign": "r", "cooldown_ticks": 0}`)
	}
	strings.write_string(&b, `]}`)
	return strings.to_string(b)

odin test core (tracking allocator): 256 leak lines attributed to the builder, all under:
256 [WARN ] --- [2026-08-13 09:05:35] <   1.98MiB/   2.56MiB> <   1.98MiB> (  797/15016) :: core.test_catalogs_load_failfast
e.g.         +++ leak         8B @ 0x4B09512B2 [builder.odin:173:_builder_stream_proc()]
detail: The 'too many archetypes' test row builds a 256-row doc with 256 aprintf allocations on the default (tracking) allocator; the string is never freed. Test-only, but leaks are CI failures per project-context.
recommended_fix: Build with context.temp_allocator and free_all after catalogs_load, or return the string and `defer delete(doc)` in check_reject_crises.
